title: Strict gates have nonempty arguments
statement: If a Boolean gate has pairwise distinct argument indices and has exactly one argument when it is a NOT gate and exactly two otherwise, then its list of argument indices is nonempty.
hypotheses_covered: The gate's argument indices are pairwise distinct.
The gate has one argument if it is a NOT gate and two arguments otherwise.
